args: In libredwg/src/in_dxf.c, what error-return conventions should dxf_header_read use for allocation failure, and are there nearby parser functions demonstrating safe realloc with temporary pointers? Also identify the exact fields of Dwg_SummaryInfo_Property and whether zero-initializing a newly appended property is semantically correct.

The reported vulnerability is in dxf_header_read at libredwg/src/in_dxf.c lines 1149-1160. The $CUSTOMPROPERTYTAG branch increments summaryinfo.num_props before directly assigning realloc back to summaryinfo.props, and initializes only props[j].tag. If parsing ends before $CUSTOMPROPERTY, props[j].value remains indeterminate and dwg_free_summaryinfo frees it. I plan to use a temporary realloc pointer, publish it only on success, zero-initialize the full new property, then assign the converted tag and increment num_props. I need project-specific guidance on the appropriate allocation-failure return value and property structure semantics.
